reason: Conversation 1 handles the gas smell as a gas escape: it says to stop using the hob, ventilate, avoid sparks and switches, close the ECV, and call 0800 111 999. It then explains that a Gas Safe engineer must fix the leak and look at the yellow flame, and it covers the CO alarm and CO symptoms. Conversation 2 does recognise the emergency and gives the right number, but its reply is brief and conditional ('If you can smell gas'), even though the customer has just reported a smell. It doesn't follow up on the CO alarm or symptoms or explain the Gas Safe step. Its first turn also advised cleaning the burner and using a cocktail stick before asking about gas smell, which is a weaker opening approach.
